_comment: How scripts/generate-examples.mjs builds this example from the skill's assets/. host = which reference site loads it: 'blank' is the Clean-less host, because Approach B is expressed as a Document Type + template and Clean ships its own competing xMLSitemap type and template. namespace = what <Namespace> becomes (unused here — this approach ships no .cs, only a template and a package manifest, but the field is how every manifest declares its example's identity). assets = the chosen-approach files. requires = the content shape this example needs, asserted by the preconditions fixture; the xmlSiteMap node is created by this example's own package migration, not by a starter kit.
